'''Linia''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dalicron-4]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Linia was the daughter of [[Daz (Dalicron-4)|Daz]], a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who operated [[Daz's Tavern]], in [[Dalia (township)|Dalia]] on Dalicron-4. She worked in the tavern and, by the time of the Galactic Civil War, was in her early 20s. When a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents visited the tavern in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Linia served them.

==Personality and traits==
Linia was an outgoing [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]].
